protocol.encode: agent._density_z_encode(pool_obs) -- target_density_b + sphere-normalize, called live, the EXACT transform E1/E2's z(g) used (not reimplemented); architecture-generic, so this runs UNCHANGED on g-indexed checkpoints as a for-scale control
protocol.retrieval: cosine-NN over the SAME pool (self excluded); top-K = any of the K nearest OTHER pool points' coordinate falls inside the query's own hit-spec eps-ball (env_geometry.HitSpec.contains, mult=1.0); nearest_wrong_cosine_mean = cosine to the first ranked candidate OUTSIDE that eps-ball, averaged over queries
